canonical_project: Wayanad AI and Data Center Park
owner: Malayalee Festival Federation (proposed PPP/collaboration with government and investors)
notes: The UNN/Global Net News report says the Malayalee Festival Federation planned to formally announce a Wayanad AI and Data Center Park in South Wayanad between Kalpetta and Nilambur, with AI R&D, innovation labs, skilling centers, and a modern data center. This appears early-stage with no published MW capacity, permits, land allocation, or construction evidence found.
